title: Add read-only stock replenishment worksheet
description: Add a development-only read-only replenishment worksheet over existing stock, product minimum/maximum stock and active product-supplier sourcing relationships. When on-hand is below the minimum and a valid maximum target exists, show a suggested top-up to that target; otherwise mark the recommendation unavailable. Supplier data is reference only and never auto-selects a supplier, creates an order or changes inventory. No migration, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible data action, secret change or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated bounded GET worksheet filters stock by warehouse and optional product, uses stable paging, and batch-loads products and sourcing relationships.
Rows distinguish below-minimum stock, valid top-up quantity, missing or invalid thresholds, and unavailable sourcing; no cross-warehouse aggregation or unit conversion is inferred.
The stock-query page opens a read-only replenishment worksheet showing current stock, thresholds, suggested quantity and sourcing references without a create-order action.
Focused unit tests cover threshold boundaries, missing products, inactive suppliers, multi-warehouse stock, paging and no-write behavior; safe Release validation passes and rules are documented.
